units.label: R
units.text: RBI introduces and upgrades safe and efficient payment systems
units.subject_rule: Economy: two separate RBI functions joined by a fake 'because'

units.label: R explains A
units.text: Payment-system upgrading explains RBI's FEMA management
units.true_fact: They are separate functions; payment systems do not explain FEMA administration.
units.subject_rule: Economy: two separate RBI functions joined by a fake 'because'

solve.steps: Both are verbatim RBI function lines; the because-test fails since forex management and domestic payments are distinct.

units.label: a
units.text: Bank Rate is the rate at which commercial banks lend
units.true_fact: That is the lending rate; Bank Rate is RBI's rate to banks.
units.subject_rule: Economy: definition of a policy rate - who lends to whom

units.label: b
units.text: Bank Rate is the rate at which commercial banks accept deposits
units.subject_rule: Economy: definition of a policy rate - who lends to whom

units.label: c
units.text: Bank Rate is the rate at which the RBI lends to commercial banks
units.subject_rule: Economy: definition of a policy rate - who lends to whom

units.label: d
units.text: Bank Rate is none of the above
units.true_fact: Bank Rate = RBI's lending/rediscount rate to banks.
units.subject_rule: Economy: definition of a policy rate - who lends to whom

solve.steps: 'Bank Rate' = the central bank's rate; only c has RBI as the lender.

units.label: a

units.true_fact: Government handles fiscal policy; RBI does monetary policy.

units.label: b
units.text: Monetary policy is made by Assocham
units.subject_rule: Economy: monetary vs fiscal authority swapped

units.label: a
units.text: Banking Control Act 1947 regulates and controls banks
units.true_fact: No such Act; the 1949 Act was originally the Banking Companies Act.
units.subject_rule: Economy: regulator vs the Act it uses (and a repealed-sounding Act)

units.label: b
units.text: SBI regulates and controls banks
units.subject_rule: Economy: regulator vs the Act it uses (and a repealed-sounding Act)

units.label: c
units.text: Regulating and controlling banks is the activity of the RBI
units.subject_rule: Economy: regulator vs the Act it uses (and a repealed-sounding Act)

units.label: d
units.text: The Banking Regulation Act 1949 regulates and controls banks (as an actor)
units.true_fact: The Act is the law; the RBI is the regulator that performs the activity.
units.subject_rule: Economy: regulator vs the Act it uses (and a repealed-sounding Act)

solve.steps: 'Activity of' needs an agent, not a statute; of the two institutions, SBI is a bank, so RBI.
solve.min_knowledge: RBI regulates banks under the BR Act 1949.

doubt: Option d is arguably defensible; key prefers the institution.
